faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Got questions? We've got answers. If you need more help, feel free to contact us.

items.a1: Optimark is an all-in-one AI-powered digital marketing platform that helps businesses schedule social media content, optimize search engine visibility (SEO), and auto-create high-quality copy tailored to their brand voice.
items.q2: Do I need a credit card to try Optimark?
items.a2: No, you do not need a credit card to start our Free tier. You get free token credits every month to try out the AI Content Maker and Content Planner.
items.q3: How does the token system work?
items.a3: Each feature (like generating a caption or doing an SEO keyword audit) consumes a specific number of tokens. Your monthly tier gives you a fresh set of tokens. If you run out, you can top-up at any time.
items.q4: Which social media platforms are supported?
items.a4: Currently, you can connect and schedule posts to Instagram, Facebook, and TikTok. We are constantly adding support for more platforms like Threads, X, and LinkedIn.
items.q5: Can I cancel or change my plan anytime?
items.a5: Yes! You can upgrade, downgrade, or cancel your subscription plan directly from your billing settings at any time with no hidden fees.

about.title: We built the tool we needed ourselves
about.description: Optimark came out of everyday marketing work: too many tabs, too many subscriptions, and a bill you only understood at the end of the month. We put it all in one place, at a price you can work out for yourself before signing up.

story.title: From seven subscriptions to one platform
paragraphs: Small marketing teams in Indonesia almost always work from a pile of tools: one to schedule posts, one for keyword research, another to make images, and a spreadsheet to stitch it all together. Each one bills monthly in dollars, and nearly all of them run far below capacity.

The hard part was never the price — it was the unpredictability. A quiet month still billed in full. A busy month hit a limit out of nowhere. And not one of those tools could answer a simple question: what did I actually spend this month, and on what?
Optimark answers both at once. Every content job lives in one place, and the cost is counted per job at rates written out in the open. No subscription runs quietly while you are not using it.

problem.label: The problem
problem.text: Tools scattered across subscriptions, costs nobody could predict, and no clear view of where the budget went.

action.label: What we did
action.text: Put content planning, SEO auditing, visual production, and ad optimisation in one platform priced per job.

result.label: The result
result.text: One place to work, one token balance you can calculate yourself, and no monthly bill running on an unused account.

who.title: Who We Are
paragraphs: Optimark is an AI-powered digital marketing platform developed and operated by PT Usaha Kreatif Indonesia. We built it for marketing teams, business owners, and content creators in Indonesia who have to ship material regularly without a large team.

The product brings five working modules together — Content Planner, SEO Analyzer, AI Content Maker, AI Image, and AI Video — under one account and one token balance. There is no monthly subscription: you buy tokens as you need them, and those tokens never expire.
The service runs under terms and a privacy policy published openly on this site, including exactly what data we collect and what it is used for.

visionMission.vision: To be the most accountable digital marketing platform in Indonesia — clear about results, and clear about cost.
missions: Bring the content work that is scattered across many tools into one workspace.
Keep pricing something users can work out for themselves before they pay.
Provide AI that speeds the work up without taking the decisions away from the person doing it.
Fit the product to the language, platforms, and audience habits of Indonesia.
